title: Content Creation & Sharing Pipeline
objective: Complete private/controlled creator interchange before any public marketplace: export/import, dependency packaging, versioning, forks/remixes, provenance, compatibility, private sharing and safe campaign instantiation, consuming SAA-18 comic-project packaging/dependency contracts and ARI resource/reference packaging instead of inventing parallel sharing or asset semantics.
acceptance: Authorized content, including eligible SAA projects, can move between explicitly authorized users/workspaces through private/controlled sharing with authorization checked before transfer or projection.
Export/import and dependency packages preserve stable content/project identity, explicit versions, dependency references, provenance and compatibility findings.
Fork/remix lineage remains explicit and source-preserving; importing or instantiating shared content cannot silently replace canonical owner history.
SAA comic projects consume sealed SAA-18 package/dependency semantics and ARI resource/reference packaging instead of creating a parallel comic or asset/provenance sharing ledger.
Identity collisions, missing dependencies, incompatible versions, prohibited or unauthorized embedded third-party resources and provenance loss fail closed with explicit findings.
Safe Campaign instantiation consumes governed owner-domain packages without silently mutating existing Campaign/World/Character or narrative truth.
Provider-off/local package creation, inspection and import remain valid where the selected transfer path is local; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
No public marketplace, public community publication, remote tester distribution, public release, commerce or broad publication authority is granted by SMB-11.
boundaries: SMB10B.1, SAA-18 and the completed SAA family remain sealed predecessors.
ARI retains canonical resource identity, rights and provenance authority; SMB-11 packages/references those records and cannot create a parallel asset registry.
SAA retains canonical comic project/page/panel/layer/history authority; sharing packages cannot silently rewrite SAA owner truth.
Private/controlled sharing is bounded to authorized users/workspaces and does not authorize public marketplace/community publication.
No public release/deployment, external beta activation, commerce or paid-provider requirement is authorized.
SMB-12 and later work remain unauthorized until fresh roadmap reconciliation after SMB-11 completes.
next_action: SMB-11 is completed_verified. SMB-12 — Real Optional AI Integrations — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
